newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia peso slips 0.35 on cenbank dollar buying.
newsitem.headline: Colombia peso slips 0.35 on cenbank dollar buying.

text.p: Colombia's peso fell 0.35 to 1,000.76 pesos to the dollar as the central bank once again intervened to prop up the U.S. currency, interbank traders said.
The session was quiet, with dealers reporting 89 trades worth a total $93 million -- about half the daily average.
"The market has been very quiet and very boring. The spread was less than one centavo of one peso," one dealer in Bogota said.

Traders said Colombia's central bank stepped in to shore up the dollar, but were unable to say what the scale of the intervention had been. The peso reached an intraday high of 1,000.75 per dollar and an intraday low 1,000.9
